canon_pressure_known_id.note: Known stable front ID -> load only the matching pressures map entry, its exact next_boundary process, and explicitly referenced causal owners. Use the canon_pressures contract before writes.

canon_pressure_registry.note: Bounded mutable front registry. Front truth is separate from visibility and player/NPC knowledge; missing executable detail remains null or empty.

canon_manifest.note: Static continuity policy and discovery only. Campaign state remains authoritative for the lived timeline.

canon_history_known_id.note: Known canon event ID -> resolve event_index to exactly one shard. Do not broaden to other visibility lanes.

canon_history_public.note: Public classification permits ambient reference, not automatic personal knowledge. Load only the smallest relevant shard.

canon_history_restricted.note: Load for world causality or when saved access or knowledge authority permits it; classification alone never informs a character.

canon_history_secret.note: World-causality route only until a saved discovery or knowledge receipt exists. Never narrate repository omniscience as character knowledge.
